text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, I'm out shopping with Agnes Tachyon.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: We got everything I wanted. Should we head back with the bags?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: …Oh? What's that over there?

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Step right up and try your luck with our New Year's raffle! This year's grand-prize is a hot spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot hamburger steak! Second-prize winners get a bushel of carrots! And third-prize winners can take home a single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Don't let this opportunity pass you by! Get a ticket now and spin for your chance to win!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I see, a raffle.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: That reminds we, we did in fact receive a raffle ticket while shopping earlier.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What are the chances? Trainer, why don't you test your luck?
choice_data_list: You don't want to give it a go?
You don't want to give it a go?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Not entirely. I'd rather observe, myself.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: When the ball rolls out from the tumbler, I wonder how its color will affect your emotional response.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Now that you know what I want, it's time to get to it. Show me the relationship between emotional responses and the mimetic muscles.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I give in to her pressure and head toward the raffle booth.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I crank the tumbler, and what pops out is…

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a grand-prize winner! Come and get the coupon for your hot spring vacation! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: And just like that… the grand-prize!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh, aren't you lucky!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Your facial muscles were at first taut with anticipation but then quickly eased into the telltale signs of a gleeful grin!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What a fascinating sight to behold!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: But to win a hot spring trip, of all things… hmm.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Yes. You should keep it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Why? you ask. Nowadays, with technology such as virtual tours, one no longer needs to leave the house if their intent is to travel.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: It's nothing but trouble having to trek all the way to some distant location. Wouldn't you agree?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: You keep the ticket. Invite a friend to go with you or something.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Well, she certainly won't be taking it back. I agree to hold onto it for now.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Looks like we have another first-prize winner! Congratulations! You get one deluxe carrot hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh! This is great!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Fresh carrot served on top of a scrumptiously succulent hamburger steak…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: If I incorporate it into this, no Umamusume would be able to resist! Heh-heh-heh!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh, nothing in particular, just talking to myself.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Let's hurry back, Trainer! Make sure you carry the food with utmost caution!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I have an unsettling feeling she's up to no good. Nevertheless, I bring the deluxe carrot hamburger steak back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: We got a second-prize winner! It's your lucky day! You're going home with a bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Wow, that's not bad at all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: This will go along well with the other items we purchased today.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: As long as it looks like a carrot, I'll be able to lure a few Umamusume in… Heh-heh.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh, nothing in particular, just talking to myself.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Let's hurry on back, Trainer. I suddenly have a pressing matter to attend to.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I have an unsettling feeling she's up to no good. Nevertheless, I bring the bushel of carrots back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Would you lookie here! You've won the third-prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh… Nice, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: The sight of you, surrounded by a throng of onlookers, with a single carrot in hand…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Like a guinea pig that's just gotten its paws on its feed!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Goodness me, how spectacular! Keep at it, my dear subservient guinea pig!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Harboring confused feelings, I quickly stuff the carrot into the shopping bag.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled a blank one! Take this pack of tissues as a consolation prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh… That was interesting to observe.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Your face was at first brimming with expectation, then quickly faded into disappointment!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: A terribly pure and honest reaction. It's amazing how much the face can convey.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: With that being said, it's kind of a shame you basically lost.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Well, I guess I'll accept the pack of tissues. It might come in handy when someone next spills something.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In a sullen mood, I head back to the academy with Agnes Tachyon.
